title: 第21章 杀人灭口
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
过了许久。

    雷老虎双眼布满血丝。

    他猛地抬起头，沾满血污的双手死死抓住栅栏。

    “弃子……他们在杀人灭口！”雷老虎五官扭曲，额头青筋根根暴起。

    林琬往前迈出半步。

    “谁在灭口？”

    “官银案根本不是我们干的。”

    雷老虎唾沫星子横飞，“是上面的大人物，他们监守自盗，吞了官银，老子和黑风寨只是个顶包的黑手套！”

    林琬握着刀柄的手指猛地收紧，这个消息实在是对于他们来讲太劲爆了。

    京城脚下，居然有人敢隐藏官银？

    “指使的人是谁？”

    “不知道。”雷老虎大口喘着粗气，

    “接头的人戴着恶鬼面具，武功极高。官银根本没运出京城，还在城里。”

    林琬转头看向身后的捕快。

    “立刻回衙门，调出近半个月出入京城的所有货运卷宗。”

    “是。”

    一队人马迅速转身，快步离开天牢。

    ……

    丁字号。

    空气冰冷。

    江梦璃盘腿坐在潮湿的草席上，锁链缠绕在她纤细的手腕和脚踝处。

    陈然走到栅栏前，将食盒放在木桌上，掀开盖子。

    一份精心烹制的菜肴出现在眼前，还带着几壶酒。

    “林琬走了，那大块头全交代了。”

    江梦璃睁开眼睛，目光从美食上扫过，最后落在陈然脸上。

    “官场的事，比魔教更脏。”江梦璃声音清冷。

    “天塌了有高个子顶着，跟我们平民百姓无关。”陈然盯着面前的绝色女子。

    虽然江梦璃在天牢里关押了几日，但好在有自己帮衬，整个牢房的环境可以说是牢内最干净的了。

    陈然穿过栏杆，坐在江梦璃身旁。

    “继续教。”

    江梦璃没有接，冷哼一声。

    “《红莲业火经》后续太过危险，你继续修炼只会走火入魔。”

    “没事，我不在意。”

    “你……！”

    江梦璃别过头，闭上眼睛。

    “足少阳胆经，转期门，入日月。气沉丹田，烈火焚心。”

    陈然听着江梦璃清冷的诵读声。

    体内的内力立刻按照路线在经脉中游走。

    他虽然学会了功法，但在某些方面还是不够细节。

    陈然放下酒杯，站起身拍掉手上的碎屑。

    “江师父教得不错。明天给加个鸡腿。”

    江梦璃猛地睁开眼。

    “你再乱叫一句试试。”

    陈然提起食盒，转身往外走。

    “明天见。”

    ……

    几日后，夜。

    天牢的铁门缓缓关上。

    陈然走在丙字号的过道里。

    【坐镇天牢，获得一年功力。】

    【累计功力：55年】

    一股内力凭空生出，融入丹田，最后归于平息。
content_en:
After a long time.

    Thunder Tiger's eyes were bloodshot.

    He raised his head suddenly, his bloody hands gripping the fence tightly.

    "Abandoned son... they are killing people and silencing them!" Lei Hu's facial features were distorted, and veins popped out on his forehead.

    Lin Wan took half a step forward.

    "Who is silencing you?"

    "The official bank case was not our fault at all."

    Thunder Tiger spit like flying stars, "They are the big shots above. They steal and steal the official money. I and Heifengzhai are just top-notch black gloves!"

    Lin Wan's fingers holding the handle of the knife tightened suddenly. This news was really too exciting for them.

    At the foot of the capital, someone actually dares to hide official silver?

    "Who is the instigator?"

    "I don't know." Lei Hu breathed heavily.

    "The person doing the connection is wearing a ghost mask and has extremely high martial arts skills. The official silver has not been shipped out of the capital at all, it is still in the city."

    Lin Wan turned to look at the policeman behind him.

    "Go back to the Yamen immediately and retrieve all the freight files that have been shipped in and out of the capital in the past half month."

    "Yes."

    A group of people quickly turned around and quickly left the prison.

    …

    T-size.

    The air was freezing.

    Jiang Mengli sat cross-legged on the damp straw mat, with chains wrapped around her slender wrists and ankles.

    Chen Ran walked to the fence, placed the food box on the wooden table, and opened the lid.

    A well-cooked dish appeared before us, along with jugs of wine.

    "Lin Wan is gone, and the big guy has explained everything."

    Jiang Mengli opened her eyes, her eyes swept over the food, and finally landed on Chen Ran's face.

    "Official matters are dirtier than the Demon Cult." Jiang Mengli's voice was cold.

    "It has nothing to do with us ordinary people if the sky is falling but tall men are holding it up." Chen Ran stared at the stunning woman in front of him.

    Although Jiang Mengli was detained in the sky jail for a few days, fortunately with his help, the environment in the entire cell could be said to be the cleanest in the prison.

    Chen Ran walked through the railing and sat next to Jiang Mengli.

    "Keep teaching."

    Jiang Mengli didn't answer and snorted coldly.

    "The follow-up of "Red Lotus Karma Fire Sutra" is too dangerous. If you continue to practice it, you will only go crazy."

    "It's okay, I don't care."

    "You...!"

    Jiang Mengli turned her head away and closed her eyes.

    "The Gallbladder Meridian of Foot Shaoyang, the transition gate, enters the sun and moon. Qi sinks into the Dantian, and fierce fire burns the heart."

    Chen Ran listened to Jiang Mengli's cold recitation.

    The internal force in the body immediately moves through the meridians according to the route.

    Although he had learned the exercises, they were still not detailed enough in some aspects.

    Chen Ran put down his wine glass, stood up and dusted off the crumbs on his hands.

    "Master Jiang taught you well. I'll add a chicken drumstick tomorrow."

    Jiang Mengli opened her eyes suddenly.

    "Try yelling again."

    Chen Ran picked up the food box, turned around and walked out.

    "See you tomorrow."

    …

    A few days later, night.

    The iron door of the prison closed slowly.

    Chen Ran walked in the aisle number C.

    [Sit in Tianlao and gain one year of skill. 】

    [Cumulative skill: 55 years]

    An internal force was born out of thin air, blended into Dantian, and finally subsided.
